headline: Front Ledger Shifts as Weathered Fighting Rekindles
war_summary: Since the last edition, WeatheredExpanseHex has become the clearest live flashpoint: five strategic-base events landed in the latest two hours, bringing its daily total to twenty-six, while the sector remains divided four Warden, four Colonial, and one neutral base. StlicanShelfHex has likewise reopened on the ledger, with two fresh events and thirteen in twenty-four hours; six Warden and three Colonial holdings remain. LinnMercyHex recorded three events in six hours and sixteen across the day, though no movement appears in the latest two hours, while its ten-to-one Colonial majority persists. MooringCountyHex posted three events in six hours and eleven in the day, but its heavy casualty and enlistment surge has cooled sharply. StonecradleHex remains contested at four Warden to five Colonial, with eight daily events, all eight within six hours. DeadLandsHex supplied two fresh events, including a Warden capture, and its casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating in the latest hour. FishermansRowHex also saw a busy twenty-four-hour ledger, but its latest six hours are quiet.
